schema_documentation:
11 top-level keys, all present in 100% of records.
- `site` str 100% — 23 enum values, all `*.ellak.gr`; top: opensource 1,440 / opengov 816 / edu 683 / mycontent 619 / creativecommons 498 (README)
- `id` str 100% — CMS post id, 1-6 chars. (site,id) pairs are unique — 0 collisions in my exact scan
- `post_title` str 100% non-empty — min 6 / mean 77.6 / max 215 chars
- `post_name` str 100% — URL slug, frequently percent-encoded Greek, mean 76.6 chars; NOT prose
- `post_date` str 100% — ISO datetime, exactly 19 chars
- `post_modified` str 100% — ISO datetime, exactly 19 chars
- `post_author` str 100% — opaque numeric author id (4-5 chars)
- `guid` str 100% — full post URL; **43 duplicate guid values** in my exact scan
- `text` str 100% present / 99.99% non-empty — min 0 / mean 4,668.8 / max 175,891 chars; the body, in Markdown
- `word_count` int 100% — I verified it equals `len(text.split())` for **all 7,284 records exactly**; trustworthy for budgeting
- `token_count` int 100% — pre-computed, mean roughly 1.35x word_count
semantic_meaning: 7,284 open-source, open-data and digital-policy blog posts from 23 ellak.gr subdomains, 2008-2026, stored as Markdown.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized title; sentiment by complete normalized review; AMNA by validated article ID; Photodentro by validated learning-object ID. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
